comparisonModel: Fixed EF Core single-transfer endpoint vs dynamic Foundgine batch endpoint

efCore.locking: explicit PostgreSQL advisory idempotency lock + deterministic SELECT ... FOR UPDATE

interpretation: The result measures the benefit of a dynamic endpoint that can accept many logical mutations and lower them into one set-based PostgreSQL execution. It is not a single-operation latency comparison.
capabilityDisclosure: EF Core is a fixed, operation-specific single-transfer endpoint. Foundgine is a dynamic capability endpoint that accepts an array of commands and batches execution.
efCoreDisclosure: The EF baseline is not vanilla out-of-the-box EF Core. EF Core does not expose a portable first-class FOR UPDATE row-lock API, so the benchmark adds raw PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE reads and the same transaction-scoped advisory idempotency lock used by the high-assurance PostgreSQL path.
